title: [3.0-beta3] Small fixes on the Treatments page
symptom: When entering the treatment page, some links are not displayed correctly in vertical view, as the text is too long (Spanish language). The only way to see it correctly is to change the position of the screen to horizontal. The date is not shown in all the events of the first option, only the time. When you are in any of the options marked in the red square and you turn the mobile horizontally, it automatically goes to the first option marked with an arrow. The option in which we are positioned is not maintained.
cause: The problem is too long translation of IOB.
fix: The translation was updated by MilosKozak.
evidence_quote: the problem is too long translation of IOB
